svg.title: Online Forms Database Panel (OFDP) - Role-Based Workflow Transformation
svg.desc: Workflow enhancement of an existing production application. Before: shared login and shared inbox. After: separate developer and client workflows isolating test and live submissions.

g.text: Workflow enhancement of an existing production application
Separate developer and client workflows so test submissions never appear in client inboxes while maintaining the existing production system.
Developers and clients shared the same workflow.
One login path for every user
All submissions visible to all users
No separation between test and live data
Developer testing mixed with production submissions.
Developers and clients now follow independent workflows.
Improved privacy by separating developer and client workflows.
Prevented developer test submissions from appearing in client inboxes.
Maintained compatibility with the existing production system.
